messages.read_aloud_failed: The reply could not be read aloud.

settings.read_aloud_hint: Show a speaker button under each reply in the hosted chat that plays it as speech.
settings.read_aloud_unavailable: Not set up on this server. An admin can turn on reading aloud in the admin panel.
settings.read_aloud_help_1: A chatter presses the speaker under a reply to hear it. Links are read as their words; code and charts are skipped.
settings.read_aloud_help_2: Each reply is read by the speech service once and saved, so playing it again costs nothing. Reading aloud does not count as a message.
